subsection.title: Target User and Core Problem
subsection.description: - Identify the main target user and the core problem this PoC should address. - Include the user's situation or current consequence when it helps explain the problem. - Mention the current workaround or evidence only when it materially clarifies the problem.

subsection.title: Value and Core Hypothesis
subsection.description: - State the value the target user should gain and why that matters. - State the single most important belief this PoC should test. - Keep it concise. Do not require a metric, customer promise, hypothesis inventory, or FAQ unless the user already has one. - Do not invent business claims or measures the user did not provide or approve.
